title: Parsley Health two plans band
description: A deep forest band with a centred eyebrow and light serif title over two square-cornered ivory plan cards side by side, one wide and one narrow. The wide card runs a six-step timeline of clover dots on a hairline, then its price, an ochre note, small print and a forest pill, with the description at the bottom right; the narrow card stacks description, a rule, price and an outlined pill. On phones the cards stack and the timeline turns vertical.
notes: the band is bg-primary and the cards bg-background, so in dark mode the band turns bone with forest cards
description takes nodes, so an underlined link can sit inside it
